title: Battle of Chaldiran
summary: On 23 August 1514 the Ottoman army under Sultan Selim I defeated the Safavid forces of Shah Ismail on the plain of Chaldiran in north-western Iran, helped by Ottoman gunpowder weapons. The Ottomans took Tabriz on 5 September but withdrew, and the Safavids later moved their capital to Qazwin; the victory secured Ottoman rule over eastern Turkey and Iraq.

uncertainty.note: Both opened sources give 23 August 1514; army sizes are not used.

where.modern_name: Chaldiran plain, Chaldoran County, West Azerbaijan Province, Iran
where.historical_name: Plain of Chaldiran between Khoi and Urumiah, Safavid Iran

importance.justification: Ottoman victory over the Safavids that fixed Ottoman control of eastern Turkey and Iraq and led the Safavids to move their capital.

audience_note: Military conflict; army sizes and casualty figures vary widely between sources and are not stated here.
